issue.title: bob periods brief gives no count behind the Finished/Dropped cap, so drafts cannot write the callout's +N more

task_type_fields.impact: Every weekly Review either omits the +N more tail the callout requires or invents a basis for it.
task_type_fields.repro:
The weekly v1 callout asks for "`^prj` completions first, then at most 7 tasks, then `+N more`". `bob periods brief 2026-W43 -f md` prints at most 7 Finished rows and 7 Dropped rows but no count of what was cut. The Done fact can't stand in for that count: it excludes the daily `^gtd` rows that Finished includes. W31's vault has 51 completions against Done 48; W30 matched (55 vs 55). Drafters fell back to phrases like "+more of 60 Done" (W29).

Root cause: `finished_section` and `dropped_section` call `truncate(ctx.finish_cap)` without recording the pre-truncation length. The Done fact comes from the stats report on a different basis. Fix: emit `total` (and `more = total - shown`) for Finished and Dropped in JSON, and print `+N more` in `-f md`.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-gr.1 note #3 and corroborated by bob-cli-gr.11, gr.13, and gr.14: the callout asks drafters for a `+N more` count that the brief never provides.
